facts.fact: Devin's vendor documentation states that its customers achieve 6-12x efficiency gains when they use Devin effectively.
facts.quote: Our customers achieve 6-12x efficiency gains when leveraging Devin effectively.

facts.fact: Devin's vendor page says its use cases are deployed across hundreds of enterprises.
facts.quote: Proven use cases deployed across hundreds of enterprises

facts.fact: Devin's vendor documentation gives an example that upgrading tens of thousands of Java files can be divided into isolated slices, each handled by an individual Devin session.
facts.quote: For example, upgrading tens of thousands of Java files can be divided into isolated slices, each tackled by an individual Devin session.

facts.fact: Devin's vendor documentation lists supported programming-language version upgrades including Java 8 to 17, Python 2 to 3, and PHP 7.x to 8.x.
facts.quote: Java 8 to 17, Python 2 to 3, PHP 7.x to 8.x

facts.fact: Devin's vendor documentation lists frontend framework upgrades of Angular 16 to 18 and React 16 to 18 as use cases.
Devin's vendor documentation lists mainframe migrations from COBOL/SAS to Python/Java as a use case.
